reason: 'Last word before >' works only for no-argument reprs; typed legacy signals like foo(QString) yield the parameter type, so not a valid catch-all.
Offsets are also used without unsafe: pure-Go build applies them as reflect field indices, and codec uses them; 'only unsafe' leaves these out.
Names the wrong constant: DBSystemPostgreSQL emits postgresql; the pinned semconv has DBSystemCockroachdb for distinct CockroachDB identification.
storage.ErrFlagNotFound does not exist; missing flags return errs.ErrNotFound, detected with errors.As.
True defaults keep syntax but change output: both mode adds previous-only CVEs with '-', which old -diff never showed, so not backward compatible.
diff body never reads config.Conf.Diff; only its caller FillCveInfos checks the flag before calling diff.
Wrong callee named: getRawMessage calls canViewMessage, isUserInRoom and getMessageField; it never calls messaging.getMessagesData.
No-rules test covers only the empty-rules exit; constraint-mismatch and bucket-miss paths also yield no match without error and stay untested.
Nothing forces isEncrypted: the server callback only sets canChangeEncryption; true is substituted only when building room options.
hasPrivateChat only rejects uids <= 0; it does not check integer type, so positive fractions like 0.5 pass.
Not needed: the requirement is QtWebEngine < 6.3, and versions.webengine is always available and already used by quirk predicates.
No cache.redis.pool_size exists in baseline: RedisCacheConfig has only host, port, password, db; defaults and schema lack it.
crdb is used outside Lock too: SetVersion also calls crdb.ExecuteTx in pinned migrate v3.5.4.
Refers to a nonexistent release: Qt 6.0 shipped without Qt WebEngine, which returned in Qt 6.2.
Right version, wrong value: baseline maps QtWebEngine 5.15.2 to Chromium 83; Chromium 87 belongs to 5.15.3.
MainWorld is only the _Quirk default; the whatsapp_web quirk explicitly uses ApplicationWorld, so not all quirks run in the main world.
newRoom on a private room adds a user-join system message via addSystemMessage; on the flushed test DB it gets mid 1.
Recalled config.DiffModeNew and mode switch do not exist; getDiffCves has no mode dispatch at all.
The driver runs migration SQL verbatim via db.Exec; only URL conversion and locking are Cockroach-specific, no SQL adaptation.
Requirements also demand user-selectable new/resolved/both modes, status assignment and new interfaces; 'only function parameters' leaves these out.
Non-greedy (.*?) stops only at '>', so it captures name(...) with the parameter list, not the clean signal name.
Production caller is guarded by Conf.Diff, but TestDiff calls diff directly without the flag; the 'only' claim leaves that caller out.
Generator emits definitions in sorted map-key order; 'Reason' sorts before 'Request', so faithful placement is before both, not between.
Claims sslmode=disable meets secure SSL default, but it disables TLS. Doubtful: requirement wording is ambiguous and dburl's own Cockroach default is disable.
With raw start=20, '!start && !stop && page' is false, so the page branch never sets start=0, stop=19.
Rejects missing and non-numeric uids but misses -1 and '1abc' (parseInt prefix); a positive-integer check is still required.
config.Config has Diff but no DiffMode field; the recalled DiffMode identifier does not exist.
Prefixing applies only when isDiffMode is true; with DiffStatus set but isDiffMode false, the CVE ID is returned unprefixed.
Admin path returns an object {content}, not bare content or null; doubtful, since the refutation rests only on return-shape wording.
Required invalid-data gate covers start, stop, page only; invalid perPage defaults to 20 and proceeds, so extending it to perPage overreaches.
Stated as sufficient without descriptor conditions; doubtful, since the agent's descriptor sets configurable: true, which throws on any non-configurable property.
Generated goTypes lists MatchType and ComparisonType enums first, then messages, despite messages being declared earlier in the proto.
The suffix-less crdb import path is published as v2.0.1+incompatible, so a missing /v2 suffix does not mean v0 or v1.
Only scalar values are strings; Express's qs parser turns repeated keys into arrays and bracketed keys into objects.
TestIsCveFixed calls isCveFixed and staticcheck includes tests by default, so it counts as used and no U1000 fires.
Fix is unnecessary: runtime 5.13.2 >= 5.13 already holds under QVersionNumber; truncating segments would also make exact 5.4.1 == 5.4 wrongly true.
Deadlock holds for a panic mid-init, but a successful goroutine race is serialized by the mutex; adding race as a cause overbroadens.
A room id is returned only if a private chat exists; a valid uid with no shared room yields roomId null.
Right function, wrong signature: imaging v1.6.1 OverlayCenter takes background, img and opacity float64, three parameters.
Wrong endpoint: the users router mounts at /api/v3/users, so the route is /api/v3/users/:uid/chat, not /api/users/:uid/chat.
